gloss: wake; vigil; all-night watch over the deceased

definitions.gloss: wake; vigil; all-night watch over the deceased
definitions.explanation: A ceremony held the night before a funeral where family and friends gather to mourn the deceased and keep watch through the night. In modern practice, it is often a shorter evening gathering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通夜|つや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。

examples.english: I wore black clothes to the wake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}られない→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{通夜|つや}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Since I can't attend the funeral due to work, I plan to at least attend the wake.

notes:
USAGE:
The traditional {通夜|つや} involved keeping vigil through the entire night, but modern {通夜|つや} (called {半通夜|はんつや}, literally "half wake") typically lasts only a few hours in the evening. It is held the day before the ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧ (funeral service).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通夜|つや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to attend a wake)
- {通夜|つや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to hold a wake)
- {通夜|つや}⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧ (food and drink served at a wake)
- お{通夜|つや} (wake, with polite prefix)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese funeral customs, the {通夜|つや} is typically followed by the ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧・⟦{告別式|こくべつしき}→告別式：05923_kokubetsushiki⟧ (funeral and farewell ceremony) the next day. Attendees usually bring ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ (condolence money) in a special envelope.
